name: Doraknus
backstory: Child of Dorakus and Darnus; grew up around sits at the square's edge through petition days,... in Salthos Cruzados, and knows something of Crossing Toll Dispute.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Nakus, named Darnakus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Prince Doran and Nakus now have a child, Nakoran.
Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.
Had a child with Dornakus, named Dornaknis.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Forliamus Log Crossing War their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Forliamus Log Crossing War as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: hears disputes from Terfila and Gorff same as always, but settles the small ones himself now instead of passing everything up the line

arc.premise: Doraknus has stopped drafting paperwork nobody trusts and started organizing a joint count instead - every post's toll box emptied and its coin weighed together in front of witnesses, so the number is counted once instead of argued four times.
